20: As an SMO/Tech Lead, I want every Scan Report file to go through one upload pipeline (quarantine, malware scan, type allowlist, schema check, storage) before anything reads it, so that a bad file is rejected before it can do harm and one or more files can be uploaded for each of the three Scan Report types. ★ effort: 11.5d

33: As an SMO/Tech Lead, I want a Remediation Planned Finding whose target date has passed to be flagged Target Date Missed, and to be made to give a new date with a reason or choose another status, so that deferred fixes don't roll on unnoticed. effort: 5.0d

FAQ: Duration Estimates

What do the duration estimates include?
  • Development effort — coding, configuration, and implementation of each dev task node
  • Unit testing (+30%) — writing and running unit tests is baked into every task duration as a 30% overhead
  • Integration testing — cross-service and integration test effort is included in task estimates
  • Code review — peer review cycles and rework from review feedback
  • Documentation — user guides, API documentation, runbooks
  • Dependency sequencing — critical path analysis determines which tasks block others and the minimum project duration
What do the duration estimates exclude?
  • E2E testing — end-to-end test suites spanning the full application stack
  • Performance / load testing — stress tests, benchmarking, and performance tuning
  • Security testing — penetration testing, vulnerability scanning, security audits
  • QA / manual testing — dedicated QA cycles and exploratory testing
  • UAT (User Acceptance Testing) — stakeholder sign-off and acceptance testing rounds
  • Accessibility audits — WCAG compliance testing (unless added as an optional node)
  • Requirements gathering — discovery, analysis, and story refinement
  • Deployment / release management — CI/CD setup, environment provisioning, release coordination
  • Data migration — migrating existing data to new schemas or systems
  • Bug fixing / hardening — post-development rework and stabilisation sprints
  • Non-functional requirements — scalability, availability, and monitoring setup beyond what is structurally derived from user stories
How are durations calculated?

Each user story is decomposed into dev task nodes via backwards dependency mapping. Every node receives a duration_days based on task complexity (Tiny=0.25d, Small=0.5–1d, Medium=1–2d, Large=3–4d, Epic=5–7d), then a 30% testing overhead (unit + integration) is applied. Estimates also include time for code review and documentation. Story effort is the sum of its owned nodes. Project duration is derived from critical path analysis — the longest chain of dependent stories that cannot be parallelised.

Durations assume AI-assisted development. Adjust upward if not using AI coding tools.

This report was generated with AI assistance. Estimates are indicative and based on AI-assisted development assumptions. Actual timelines may vary based on team velocity, scope changes, and external dependencies. Always validate with your team before committing to delivery dates.
